PR5, last. Inside the group solve, one variable per member return; the equations are regular-tree equations whose solution is the μ node; Types::close_bounds (mod.rs ~749) is the existing solver and its 'if has_vars { continue }' is where the recursive case is dropped today. Fold when the equation is regular; where it is not, an explicit declared abstraction, never silent widening. Budgets are deleted here and nowhere earlier.
